notes:
What's new in 0.1.102:
- Beebo Relay: a new "Use Beebo Relay" button on Get Started and in Settings. You accept the terms first, and Beebo never turns Relay on by itself. The status is honest: if your permission has run out, or Relay is paused, over its monthly limit or unavailable, it says so instead of "enabled". Watching at home keeps working.
- Away from home: a quality picked in the web player or on a phone can no longer go above your away-from-home quality limit.
- Limited profiles: missing-sequel hints are hidden from limited viewers in the browser Sequels list and on the Up next card. A restricted profile that has "See photos" gets thumbnails and the viewer. A limited adult can delete their own account (a child profile still asks the owner).
- Live TV: leftover stream cache folders in a custom time-shift folder are cleaned up (a link is never followed), and a stream that fails to start removes its own folder.
- Web player and older TVs: the Up next card appears a minute before an episode ends, Next has a word, the TV full-screen button keeps the page buttons on screen, a lost connection is shown honestly, and the Quality, Cinema, install banner, Watch Together and speaker controls keep their spacing on older browsers.
- Movie versions and Up next: the preferred file shows why it was chosen, follows this connection's limit and hides files the viewer may not see. Up next steps over a missing season to the next episode, and an embedded default subtitle no longer confuses the subtitle type.
- Smaller fixes: ordinary logs no longer record private media details, a finished Music scan stays finished when an older answer arrives late, a failed Prepare Queue read says so instead of showing an empty list, and Campsite phone speakers fit the measured distance between a pair.
- Not yet checked: none of this has been tried on the installed app on a real PC or on an old TV. Automated tests and reviews only.
- Release source commit fbbfcc094.
